regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative leadership structure in China A-shares with Coal as the sole eligible theme (rank 1, trend-gate eligible) and only 2 of 22 themes passing the eligibility gate. However, the backtest verdict explicitly states the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), and the track record shows dir_accuracy of 0.337 — meaning even the historical directional calls have been wrong more often than right. This is a discipline-not-prediction regime: momentum rank is a focus lens (~rank-IC 0), no validated forward edge, so I express at most one low-conviction conditional lean.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (ineligible, trend-tagged, breadth 0.0) establishes a CONFIRMED leadership handoff: if 515400.SS or equivalent gold-miner proxy becomes trend-gate eligible AND closes the current 0.057 score margin to Coal, that would retire the one-narrative Coal read.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is simultaneously rank 1, trend-gate eligible, and uncrowded (crowding_z 0.59, crowded=false), with the highest durability_bar (0.52) among eligible names. The one-narrative structure with Coal as headline and a challenger (Gold Miners, ineligible) that is NOT confirmed suggests the allocator's own trend discipline would keep the single eligible theme on, absent a shake-out. I lean with that structural state, not because the rank 'predicts' anything.
theses.dissent: Coal's hurst_tag is mean-revert, breadth is only 0.5, and this market's history shows the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown — so the eligibility flag itself is the weakest leg here; the theme could whipsaw and hand leadership back quickly.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
